text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The PC platform began with the release of the IBM Personal Computer in 1981 and grew into one of the largest gaming and computing ecosystems. Early PC games were distributed through floppy disks and focused on text adventures, strategy, simulations, and role-playing games. The DOS era introduced many influential titles before Windows expanded PC gaming with improved graphics, multimedia support, and wider accessibility. Over time, the platform evolved through VGA graphics, sound cards, 3D acceleration, online gaming, and digital distribution. Modern PCs continue to support a wide range of games from classic software preservation to current releases.
